title: The Fair Maid of Perth
librettist: J.-H. Vernoy de Saint-Georges and J. Adenis based on W. Scott

synopsis.text:
The setting is Perth, Scotland, circa 1400. The "Fair Maid" is Catharine Glover, daughter of a glovemaker in Perth, who kisses Henry Smith, the armorer, while he is sleeping, on Valentine's Day. Smith proposes marriage, and although Catharine refuses at first, she marries him at the end of the book. There is a parallel plot concerning the romance of David Stewart, Duke of Rothesay, the son of Robert III of Scotland, and Louise the Glee-Maiden.
